SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Special Branch S.S. Station
File No. REGISTRY
1801
14 10 32
Date October 14, 19 32.

Subject (in full) Russian Cabaret Girls, "Red Agents."

Made by D.S. Moore. Forwarded by [Signature]

Regarding that portion of the attached translation of an
article which appeared in the local Russian newspaper "Vechernoe
Vremia" on September 30, 1932, concerning the alleged "Red"
activities of Russian females, employed in local cabarets as
dancing partners, amongst foreign troops stationed in Shanghai.
Enquiries have been made amongst the Police Authorities of both
the British and American forces in an effort to ascertain details
of any specific cases as quoted, which may have come to their
notice. The British Military Police are of the opinion that the
average British soldier is not in the slightest interested in the
class of propaganda emanating from Russian sources and that if any
attempts were made by Soviet agents to further their cause through
the medium of individual soldiers the fact would soon be reported
to the proper authorities. The local American Marine Corps
Provost Staff, agrees that many of their men have formed
alliances and attachments with Russian girls working in
cabarets, and although viewing the possibility of the successful
or partially successful completion of the machinations of Soviet
agents amongst their forces, are unable to quote any definite
case which has been brought to their notice.
Police enquiries reveal that the only females suspected
of being engaged in the class of work under discussion are Raissa
S. Borodavkina, Vivian Baitsky and one S. Kirienko. The former
was recently arrested as a communist suspect by the Chefoo Police,
but later released. Vivian Baitsky, resides at No.2 Pacific
Gardens, Seymour Road and is employed at Browning's Cafe,
Broadway, a resort frequented by soldiers and sailors, particularly
Americans. According to information on record, both the above
named have been suspected of disseminating communist propaganda

主题（全称）：俄国歌舞厅女郎，“红色代理人”。

制作人：D.S. Moore。转呈人：[签名]

关于附件中译文的一部分，该译文源自1932年9月30日当地俄文报纸《晚报》（Vechernoe Vremia）上刊登的一篇文章，内容涉及受雇于本地歌舞厅担任驻沪外籍军队舞伴的俄国女性所谓的“红色”活动。已向英美两国军队的警察当局进行调查，以查明引文中提到的任何具体案件的细节，这些案件可能已引起他们的注意。英国宪兵认为，普通英国士兵对源自俄国的这类宣传丝毫不感兴趣，如果苏联代理人试图通过个别士兵来推进其事业，这一事实很快就会报告给有关当局。当地美国海军陆战队纠察人员同意，他们的许多士兵已与在歌舞厅工作的俄国女孩建立了联盟和亲密关系，尽管他们视苏联代理人在其部队中成功或部分成功完成阴谋的可能性为存在，但无法引用任何已引起他们注意的确切案例。
警方调查显示，唯一被怀疑从事此类工作的女性是 Raissa S. Borodavkina、Vivian Baitsky 和一位 S. Kirienko。前者最近被烟台警方作为共产党嫌疑人逮捕，但随后获释。Vivian Baitsky 居住在西摩路（Seymour Road）太平洋花园2号，受雇于百老汇的布朗宁咖啡馆（Browning's Cafe），这是一个士兵和水手，特别是美国人常去的场所。根据记录在案的信息，上述两人均被怀疑自1930年末以来在外籍军队中散布共产党宣传

D. REGISTRY
1901
5 / 6 / 32

Translation of an article which appeared in the VECHERNIAA
VREMA, September 30, 1932 and contributed by A. Nikulteff

THE WORK OF THE COMINTERN ( COMMUNIST INTERNATIONAL)
IN SHANGHAI IS CARRIED OUT STRICTLY IN ACCORDANCE
TO PLAN AND IS DIRECTED TO SPREAD PROPAGANDA AMONG
THE CHINESE MASSES AND FOREIGN TROOPS AND TO
DISINTEGRATE AND PROVOKE RUSSIAN EMIGRANTS.

The local authorities have reasons to be worried by the
increased activity of agents of the Comintern, which finds its
expression in frequent communist demonstrations, labour disturbances
and strikes, and in almost daily seizures of communist handbills
by the police.

Frequent arrests of communists do not seem to interfere very
much with the plans of the Comintern, and this shows the efficiency
and the strict secrecy of the local section of this international
organization.

As a rule, the arrested communists prove to be ordinary members
of the party, who only carry out instructions received from their
leaders whom they cannot point out even if they wish to do so,
because they know very little about them.

WHO DIRECTS THE WORK.

We are in a position to publish in this newspaper some data
regarding the organization of this branch of the Comintern, covering,
like a net, all more or less important towns of China and especially
Shanghai. Some considerable time ago the Moscow centre found it
necessary "in the interests of the work" to transfer the more
responsible work abroad from the hands of Russian communists to
foreigners, or to Russians who have a perfect knowledge of some
foreign language and can live under the guise of foreigners.
Particular attention is paid in this connection to towns with large
'white' Russian communities, as it frequently happens that
responsible communist agents are denounced by emigrants thereby
upsetting the work of the whole organizations.

D. 登记处
1901
32年6月5日

翻译自1932年9月30日《VECHERNIAA VREMA》（《晚间时报》）刊登、由 A. 尼库尔特夫 (A. Nikulteff) 撰写的文章

共产国际（共产主义国际）在上海的工作严格按照计划进行，旨在向中国民众和外国军队散布宣传，并瓦解和挑衅俄国流亡者。

地方当局有理由对共产国际代理人活动的增加感到担忧，其表现为频繁的共产主义示威、劳工骚乱和罢工，以及警方几乎每日查获共产主义传单。

频繁逮捕共产党人似乎并未对共产国际的计划造成太大干扰，这表明该国际组织本地分部的高效运作和严格保密。

通常情况下，被捕的共产党人被证实为普通党员，他们仅执行来自上级的指示，即使他们愿意，也无法指认这些上级，因为他们对上级的情况知之甚少。

谁在指导工作。

本报有能力公布有关共产国际这一分支组织的一些资料，该组织像一张网一样覆盖了中国所有较为重要的城镇，尤其是上海。不久前，莫斯科中心认为“为了工作利益”，有必要将更负责任的工作从俄国共产党人手中转移到外国人，或转移到精通某种外语并能以外国人身份生活的俄国人手中。在此方面，特别关注拥有大量“白”俄社区的城镇，因为负责任的共产主义代理人经常遭到流亡者的告发，从而扰乱整个组织的工作。

page_data.en:
-2-

The appearance of agents of this type has been noticed in
Shanghai, especially recently. In most cases they pose as Germans
or Austrians.

THE MAIN THREE OBJECTS.

It is said that at the head of the organization engaged in the
spreading communist propaganda in Shanghai and neighbourhood is a
"foreigner" of this type, who has large sums deposited in banks and
who, being in a close touch with Moscow, directs the work of the
Comintern in this part of the world.

The following are the three main objects of the communist
activity in Shanghai :-

1. Spreading propaganda among the Chinese masses.
2. Spreading propaganda among the foreign troops and navies.
3. Desintegration and provoking of White Russian emigrants.

The first point, i.e. the work amongst the Chinese, is, of course,
the most important one. For this purpose the head of the local
Comintern organization has 5 or 6 Chinese communists working under
him, who are graduates of a special school for propaganda in Moscow,
and have proved their loyalty to the communist party. Only these
agents are in touch with the head of the organization, only they
know the leader, from whom they receive instructions and funds for
propaganda work.

SPHERES OF COMMUNIST ACTIVITY.

Each of these 5 agents is in charge of a particular section
carrying out work in a particular field, and is vested with power to
act on his own initiative.. Only general supervision and direction
of the work is in the hands of the head of the organization, who
receives information regarding the activities of his subordinates from
reports submitted by them and from reports of his personal intelligence
service - (a necessary part of any Soviet organization).

These sections are as follows :-

1) Party Section, i.e. section directing the activity of the Chinese
Communist Party in Shanghai, its relation and co-operation with the
page_data.zh:
-2-

此类代理人的出现已在上海被注意到，尤其是最近。在大多数情况下，他们伪装成德国人或奥地利人。

三个主要目标。

据说，负责在上海及周边地区散布共产主义宣传的组织由一名此类“外国人”领导，他在银行存有巨款，并与莫斯科保持密切联系，指导共产国际在世界这一区域的工作。

以下是共产主义在上海活动的三个主要目标：

1. 向中国民众散布宣传。
2. 向外国军队和海军散布宣传。
3. 瓦解和挑衅白俄流亡者。

第一点，即在中国人中的工作，当然是最重要的一点。为此，当地共产国际组织的负责人手下有5或6名中国共产党员为其工作，他们是莫斯科一所特殊宣传学校的毕业生，并已证明其对共产党的忠诚。只有这些代理人与组织负责人联系，只有他们认识这位领导者，并从他那里接收宣传工作的指示和资金。

共产主义活动的领域。

这5名代理人每人负责一个特定部门，在特定领域开展工作，并被赋予主动行事的权力。只有工作的总体监督和指挥权掌握在组织负责人手中，他通过下属提交的报告及其个人情报机构（任何苏维埃组织的必要组成部分）的报告来获取有关其下属活动的信息。

这些部门如下：

1) 党务部，即指导中国共产党在上海的活动、其与其他城镇共产主义组织的关系与合作，以及反对偏离党的政治路线的左倾和右倾倾向的部门。

page_data.en:
-3-
communist organizations in other towns, and the struggle against left
and right deviations from party's politics.
2) Labour Section-conducting propaganda among workers in Shanghai,
recruiting new members for the party, incitting workers against the
administration of factories, and organizing strikes. Creating
incidents leading to individual or mass dismissal of workers and
to unemployment - is particularly encouraged, as dissatisfied workers
are easily lead and incited to stage demonstrations and disturbances
of all sorts.
3) Students' Section. This section is the most favourable field for
the destructive activity of the Comintern. Chinese students are
easily inflamed by the promises contained in the communist slogans.
They join the communist party and participate eagerly in all
demonstrations and disturbances.
4 & 5) These sections conduct propaganda among sailors and soldiers.
Creating dissatisfaction in the army and navy and organization of
communist cells for spreading communist propaganda in their ranks
is the most important part of work of agents of the Comintern.
 Secondly Agents.
Apart from the five chief agents enumerated above, each of whom is
in charge of a special section, there are other agents who do not carry
out any definite work, but are transferred to one of the above mentioned
sections when-ever necessary.
Each agent, in turn, controls the activity of several other agents
through whom he carries out instructions received from the head of the
organization. These secondary agents are actually engaged in the
organization of strikes, demonstrations and disturbances. Here also
students and workers are their most ardent followers and take the most
active part in communist activity, and the majority of individuals who
fall into hands of the police are of this type. Thus in the case of a
communist base being discovered, the principal leaders invariably
succeed in making good their escape.
Cases like the sensational arrest of Nasser in Shanghai in 1925 and
the Houlens case are very rare.
page_data.zh:
-3-
2) 劳工部——在上海工人中进行宣传，为党招募新成员，煽动工人反对工厂管理层，并组织罢工。特别鼓励制造导致工人个别或集体被解雇以及失业的事件，因为不满的工人很容易被引导和煽动举行各种示威和骚乱。
3) 学生部。该部门是共产国际破坏性活动最有利的领域。中国学生很容易因共产主义口号中包含的承诺而激动。他们加入共产党，并热衷于参与所有示威和骚乱。
4 & 5) 这些部门在水手和士兵中进行宣传。在军队和海军中制造不满情绪，并组织共产主义小组以在其队伍中散布共产主义宣传，是共产国际代理人工作中最重要的部分。
其次级代理人。
除了上述五名各负责一个专门部门的主要代理人外，还有其他代理人，他们不承担任何固定工作，但在需要时会被调派到上述任何一个部门。
每名代理人反过来控制着其他几名代理人的活动，并通过他们执行来自组织负责人的指示。这些次级代理人实际上从事组织罢工、示威和骚乱的工作。在这里，学生和工人也是他们最热情的追随者，并在共产主义活动中发挥最积极的作用，落入警方手中的大多数人属于此类。因此，一旦共产主义基地被发现，主要领导人 invariably（总是）能成功逃脱。
像1925年在上海轰动一时的纳赛尔 (Nasser) 被捕案和胡伦斯 (Houlens) 案这样的情况非常罕见。

page_data.en:
-4-

Girls from ..... the USSR

As it was stated above, apart from the work among the Chinese, considerable attention is paid to spreading propaganda in the ranks of foreign troops. Here the principal agents are the so called dancing partners - communists who arrive from the USSR for this Special purpose.

These girls, accordingly instructed, can be found in every port where foreign men-of-war or foreign troops are stationed.

Having picked out a suitable individual the girl attracts him by flirting, becomes his paramour and endeavours by all means to cause him spend his money, to incur debts, and also gets him into the habit of using narcotics.

When the man is "ready" i.e. sufficiently weakened morally and involved in debts, the girl introduces him to her "friend" - an agent of the Comintern. The agent carries on the work on the same lines i.e. takes the man round the cabarets, lends money to him, and, finally, the victim is caught in the trap cleverly set up for him, and is forced to accept the terms of the agent.

The latter, having the victim helpless in his hands, open his cards and forces the man to join the communist party threatening, should he refuse to do so, him to denounce him and to demand payment of his debts. Very often the man consents to organize a communist cell on board his ship or in his company, and carries out the special instructions of the agent.

A. Negaitseff.
page_data.zh:
-4-

来自……苏联的女孩

如上所述，除了在中国人中的工作外，相当多的注意力被放在向外籍军队队伍中散布宣传上。这里的主要代理人是所谓的舞伴——为此特殊目的从苏联前来的共产党人。

这些女孩接受相应指令，出现在驻扎有外国军舰或外国军队的每个港口。

在挑选出合适的目标后，女孩通过调情吸引他，成为他的情妇，并千方百计促使他花钱、负债，还让他养成使用毒品的习惯。

当此人“准备好”时，即在道德上足够软弱且陷入债务困境，女孩将他介绍给她的“朋友”——一名共产国际代理人。该代理人沿相同路线开展工作，即带此人去歌舞厅，借钱给他，最终，受害者落入精心设置的陷阱，被迫接受代理人的条件。

后者将受害者牢牢控制在手中，亮出底牌，强迫此人加入共产党，威胁如果拒绝，就告发他并要求偿还债务。此人往往同意在其船只或连队中组织共产主义小组，并执行代理人的特别指示。

A. 涅盖采夫 (Negaitseff)。

Special Branch B.2.xxxxx

October 1, 1932.

Subject (in full) Arrest of Raissa S. Borodavkina, Suspected Soviet Agent.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the attached translation from the
French Police Daily Intelligence Report dated September 29, 1932,
on the subject of Raissa Borodavkina, I have to state that
according to information the Chefoo Police made an examination
of the passports of all persons residing at the New World Hotel
on August 14, and it was discovered that Borodavkina was in
possession of two passports namely a Russian Emigrant's and a
Chinese. On August 17 she was arrested on suspicion of being a
communist agent. A certain Li, a wealthy Chinese, who acted as
Russian interpreter and who translated documents found in
Borodavkina's room, is reported to have mentioned in conversation
with an informant that the Chinese authorities had proof of her
communistic activities, and that correspondence, and literature
of a pro-communist nature was found in her room.

It was believed in Chefoo that the information regard-
ing Borodavkina's activity was received by the Chefoo police from
a certain Antashevitch, a German employed with the Tsingtao police.

After about a week's detention Borodavkina was released
on a guarantee bond supplied by Mr. Ross (?), American of
Russian Jewish extraction, owner of the Beach Cafe, where she
was employed at that time, and a member of the U.S. Navy, who is
reported to be her paramour. It was rumoured in Chefoo that
the Chinese authorities were bribed by Borodavkina's friends.
After her release she continued to work at the Beach Cafe.

Endeavours are being made to verify the above
information and matters of interest will be duly reported.

[签名: G. Tcheremshansky]
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

鉴于附上的1932年9月29日法国警察每日情报报告中关于赖莎·博罗达夫金娜 (Raissa Borodavkina) 的译文，我必须陈述，根据烟台警方提供的信息，他们在8月14日检查了新世界酒店所有居住者的护照，发现博罗达夫金娜持有两本护照，即一本俄国流亡者护照和一本中国护照。8月17日，她因涉嫌为共产主义代理人而被捕。据报道，一位姓李的富有的中国人，担任俄语翻译并翻译了在博罗达夫金娜房间发现的文件，他在与线人的谈话中提到，中国当局掌握了她从事共产主义活动的证据，并在她的房间里发现了具有亲共性质的信件和文献。

烟台方面认为，关于博罗达夫金娜活动的情报是由一名受雇于青岛警方的德国人安塔舍维奇 (Antashevitch) 提供给烟台警方的。

在被拘留约一周后，博罗达夫金娜由罗斯 (?) 先生提供担保债券获释。罗斯先生是美国人，具有俄国犹太血统，是当时博罗达夫金娜任职的海滩咖啡馆 (Beach Cafe) 的老板，据称也是她的情夫，且为美国海军成员。烟台有谣言称，中国当局收受了博罗达夫金娜朋友的贿赂。获释后，她继续在海滩咖啡馆工作。

目前正在努力核实上述信息，如有感兴趣的事项将及时报告。

[签名: G. 切列姆尚斯基 (Tcheremshansky)]
D. S.
特科主管警官。

Memorandum on Raissa Samuilovna Borodavkina

R.S. Borodavkina first came to the notice of the
Shanghai Municipal Police in December 1930 when information
was received to the effect that she was suspected of being
engaged in spreading "red" propaganda among sailors of
foreign navies.

From enquiries made it was learned that she had
arrived in Shanghai from Harbin via Tsingtao some time
during the autumn of 1929. While in Harbin, about six
years ago, she was reported to have been in charge of the
local "Pioneer" organization (a communist organization for
children - preparatory stage for the "Communist Youth").
Later she became a dancing partner and in this capacity has
been working in cabarets in Harbin, Tsingtao, Chefoo and
Shanghai.

During the summer of 1929 she was employed at the
"Arcadia" Cafe, Shantung Road, Tsingtao, but was dismissed
from that place as a result of information received by the
management that she was a Soviet sympathiser and had been
spreading red propaganda among sailors who frequented the
establishment.

In Shanghai she was employed at the Browning's Cabaret,
No.68 Broadway until the end of June, 1931, when she left
for Chefoo. At that time she resided at No.4 Astor Road
where she shared a room with V.M. Roetskaya, also a
professional dancing partner. On the strength of
information alleged to have been furnished by a U.S.
sailor named Keaton, attached to Submarine 38, who made
the acquaintance of Roetskaya in Tsingtao, she was reported

关于赖莎·萨穆伊洛夫娜·博罗达夫金娜 (Raissa Samuilovna Borodavkina) 的备忘录

上海公共租界警务处首次注意到 R.S. 博罗达夫金娜是在1930年12月，当时收到情报称她涉嫌在外籍海军水手中散布“赤色”宣传。

经查询得知，她于1929年秋季的某个时候经青岛从哈尔滨抵达上海。据报道，大约六年前在哈尔滨期间，她负责当地的“先锋”组织（一个儿童共产主义组织——“共产主义青年团”的准备阶段）。后来她成为舞女，并以此身份在哈尔滨、青岛、烟台和上海的歌舞厅工作。

1929年夏季，她受雇于青岛山东路的“阿卡迪亚” (Arcadia) 咖啡馆，但因管理层收到情报称她是苏维埃同情者并在光顾该场所的水手中散布赤色宣传而被解雇。

在上海，她受雇于百老汇路68号的布朗宁歌舞厅 (Browning's Cabaret)，直到1931年6月底前往烟台。当时她居住在阿斯特路4号，与同为职业舞女的 V.M. 罗茨卡娅 (Roetskaya) 合住一间房。据称基于一名名叫基顿 (Keaton) 的美国水手提供的情报，该水手隶属于38号潜艇，在青岛结识了罗茨卡娅，据报道

The room occupied by Borodavkina and Roetskaya at
No.4 Astor Road was frequented by foreign sailors among
whom was one named Jack Shnell, of the U.S.S. "Chaumont,"
a member of the Medical Staff of the U.S.A. Navy. This
individual, who is a Russian Jew by origin is said to be a
Soviet sympathiser and it is believed that he was then
Borodavkina's paramour.

Upon her return from Chefoo in 1931 Borodavkina
was employed at the Ritz Cafe, No.29 Rue Chu Pao San.
During this period she resided at No.570 Avenue Joffre,
a Chinese boardinghouse. In June 1932 she left for
Chefoo where, according to our information, she is
residing at the New World Hotel and is employed at
the Beach Cafe.

Borodavkina's name was mentioned in a pamphlet
posted by an anonymous group of "White" Russians in
December 1931 denouncing local Soviet agents and
sympathisers (file D.1860).

Raissa Samuilovna Borodavkina is a Russian of Jewish
origin and is about 25 years of age. She is not registered
with the local Russian Emigrants Organization or any other
similar society. From a statement made by her sister
Mrs. E.S. Schwartz in May 1930 when applying at the local
Netherlands Consulate-General for a visa, it would appear
that they have three brothers who at that time resided at
Urga, Detroit (U.S.A.) and Moscow respectively. Mrs.E.S.
Schwartz was formerly the paramour of S. Mamontoff,
suspected Soviet agent (file D.1261).

博罗达夫金娜（Borodavkina）和罗埃茨卡娅（Roetskaya）在阿斯特路4号（Astor Road）居住的房间常有外国水手光顾，其中包括美国海军“肖蒙”号（U.S.S. "Chaumont"）医务处成员、名为杰克·施内尔（Jack Shnell）的一人。此人为俄裔犹太人，据称是苏联同情者，且被认为当时是博罗达夫金娜的情夫。

1931年从烟台返回后，博罗达夫金娜受雇于朱葆三路29号的丽兹咖啡馆（Ritz Cafe）。在此期间，她居住在霞飞路570号的一家华人寄宿公寓。1932年6月，她前往烟台，据我方情报显示，她现居住于新世界酒店，并在海滩咖啡馆（Beach Cafe）任职。

博罗达夫金娜的名字曾出现在1931年12月由一群匿名“白”俄张贴的小册子中，该小册子谴责当地的苏联特工及同情者（档案 D.1860）。
